RoraFreeze started with a simple problem: my phone would run out of memory and battery quickly whenever I played mobile games. Since my phone is not a flagship, background apps could make gaming feel slower and less consistent.

I searched for a solution and found the open-source Essentials app. I liked it, but I realized I only needed one feature: App Freezing. So I decided to build my own focused version, centered around freezing apps I rarely use.

The name Rora comes from Aurora, a Mobile Legends hero whose ability freezes enemies in battle. The name fits the idea behind the app: RoraFreeze freezes the apps you rarely use so they stay out of the way.

When an app is frozen, it cannot continue running normally in the background. This can help reduce unnecessary RAM, battery, and data usage. For older and mid-range phones, this can mean a cleaner background, fewer unnecessary processes, and potentially smoother gaming.

RoraFreeze is built around one simple idea: Freeze what you do not use. Keep your phone focused on what matters.
